gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma based on clinical evidence and radiographic (MRI) imaging.

candidate_evidence.quote: The aim of this trial is to determine the efficacy and safety of 131I-omburtamab in patients with DIPG that have not progressed following external beam radiation therapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Clinical and/or radiographic (MRI) progression of tumor in the period between external beam radiation therapy and signing of ICF.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: SPECT/CT scans will be performed at 4h, 12h, 24h, 72h and 7 days after the first administration of 131I-omburtamab.

role_evidence.quote: The proposed intervention includes surgical placement using standard stereotactic techniques of a small caliber cannula into the tumor in the pons followed by positive pressure infusion (i.e. CED) of 131I-omburtamab.

agents.drug_class_hint: iodine-131 radiolabelled murine IgG1 anti-CD276 (B7-H3) monoclonal antibody; isotope 131I
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: monoclonal antibody recognizing CD276 (B7-H3), delivering iodine-131

coder_notes: DIPG-only trial in children and young adults (age 3 to <21), so not_glioblastoma. 131I-omburtamab is given by convection-enhanced delivery through a stereotactic intratumoral cannula (registered device), so device_dependent true and formulation_flag new_route. The single arm is labelled OTHER but is the experimental arm. SPECT/CT and blood sampling are for dosimetry; no tumour tissue or CSF drug concentration is stated, so tumour_pk_planned coded no (adjudicator may consider SPECT dosimetry as imaging-based tumour exposure). B7-H3 expression is not an entry requirement or stated biomarker endpoint.
